test_PCAMatrix: test a PCA transform that reduces 64-dim vectors to 10 principal components and verifies energy decreases per component
test_HadamardRotation: test a Hadamard rotation transform that preserves L2 norms for power-of-2 dimension vectors
test_IndexScalarQuantizer: test an 8-bit scalar quantizer index that compresses vectors and searches with correct distance reconstruction

test_merge_knn_results: test merging KNN results from multiple shards by combining distance and ID arrays and keeping top-k nearest neighbors
